# Gavin Reis

> Electrical & Computer Engineering at Cornell. I design systems end to end and
> put them in front of real users.

Personal engineering portfolio. Static site, no tracking beyond privacy-friendly
page analytics. Every status is stated: shipped work links to something running,
and anything in progress or not launched says so.

## Projects

- Embedded Intent: my web and AI automation agency for local service businesses;
  eleven priced services and a one-command quality gate on every change.
  Live: https://www.embeddedintent.com/ · Code: https://github.com/GavinR-7/embedded-intent
- HQ (building): a multi-agent operations system that runs my agency work and
  school planning; SQLite work orders with leased, attempt-bound claims and
  hash-bound approvals; 120+ automated tests. Code is private.
- 32-bit RISC-V processor (ECE 2300): a single-cycle TinyRV1 core in Verilog,
  arithmetic built from gates, running RISC-V assembly on an FPGA. Course code is private.
- [John Savoretti Realty](https://www.gavinreis.com/projects/john-savoretti-realty) (building):
  site for a two-office Long Island brokerage. Residential, rental and commercial
  listings share one typed pipeline built on TypeScript discriminated unions.
  Preview: https://john-savoretti-realty.vercel.app/
- Above All Tents: first site designed, built, shipped and sold end to end.
  Live: https://abovealltents.com/
- [GC Kuts](https://www.gavinreis.com/projects/gc-kuts) (prototype, not launched):
  mobile-first site built for a friend, an independent barber whose business runs
  through Instagram. Preview: https://gckuts-site.vercel.app/
- The Ledger: Prototype exploring how to present reporting without editorial
  slant. Runs on sample articles, not live news.
  Live: https://the-ledger-ashen.vercel.app/

## In progress (no deployment yet)

- Canvas Course Archiver — archives Cornell Canvas courses into a queryable manifest
- ECE Course Tutor — retrieval-augmented tutor over that archive, with citations
- PDF Reader — reads a PDF aloud with the current sentence highlighted
- Inkline — handwriting-to-text with a CER/WER eval harness as the release gate
- AI legal triage — jurisdiction-aware legal information tool, gated on escalation-recall evals
